newsitem.title: USA: Transamerica completes sale to Household.
newsitem.headline: Transamerica completes sale to Household.

text.p: Transamerica Corp completed the sale of its consumer lending unit to Household International and expects it to result in a second quarter after-tax gain of $275 million, or $4.01 a share.
The gain will occur after taking into account taxes, writedowns of intangibles and other items.
As previously announced, proceeds from the deal will total $3.9 billion, or $1.1 billion after repayment of associated debt. The deal was announced May 21, 1997.

Proceeds will also be used to buy Transamerica's common stock and for other corporate purposes. Transamerica previously announced its board has authorized the purchase of up to 6 million of the company's common shares.
